mapper.sql: s.SLIDE_ID, s.TITLE, s.SUB_TEXT, s.BADGE_TEXT, s.BG_COLOR, s.IMAGE_URL, s.IMAGE_ALT, s.PRODUCT_CD, s.LINK_URL, s.CHANNELS, s.START_DT, s.END_DT, s.SORT_ORD, s.USE_YN, s.UPD_AT, s.UPD_BY, p.PRODUCT_NM, p.ON_SALE_YN AS PRODUCT_ON_SALE_YN, p.DETAIL_URL AS PRODUCT_URL
i.SECTION_CD, i.PRODUCT_CD, i.SORT_ORD, i.BADGE_TEXT, i.USE_YN, p.PRODUCT_NM, p.PRODUCT_KIND, p.SUB_TYPE, p.SUMMARY, p.RATE_TEXT, p.ICON, p.DETAIL_URL, p.ON_SALE_YN
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_PRD_TAB_SLIDE s LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_CD = s.PRODUCT_CD WHERE s.USE_YN = 'Y' AND s.START_DT <= #{baseDt} AND s.END_DT >= #{baseDt} AND (s.PRODUCT_CD IS NULL OR p.ON_SALE_YN = 'Y') ORDER BY s.SORT_ORD, s.SLIDE_ID
SELECT SECTION_CD, SECTION_NM, SECTION_DESC, SECTION_TYPE, CARD_ICON, LINK_URL, SORT_ORD, USE_YN FROM TB_PRD_TAB_SECTION WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD, SECTION_CD

SELECT FROM TB_PRD_TAB_ITEM i JOIN TB_PRD_TAB_SECTION sec ON sec.SECTION_CD = i.SECTION_CD AND sec.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_CD = i.PRODUCT_CD WHERE i.USE_YN = 'Y' AND p.ON_SALE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY i.SECTION_CD, i.SORT_ORD, i.PRODUCT_CD
SELECT FROM TB_PRD_TAB_SLIDE s LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_CD = s.PRODUCT_CD ORDER BY s.USE_YN DESC, s.START_DT DESC, s.SORT_ORD, s.SLIDE_ID
SELECT FROM TB_PRD_TAB_SLIDE s LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_CD = s.PRODUCT_CD WHERE s.SLIDE_ID = #{slideId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRD_TAB_SLIDE (TITLE, SUB_TEXT, BADGE_TEXT, BG_COLOR, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_ALT, PRODUCT_CD, LINK_URL, CHANNELS, START_DT, END_DT, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY) VALUES (#{title}, #{subText}, #{badgeText}, #{bgColor}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageAlt}, #{productCd}, #{linkUrl}, #{channels}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{sortOrd}, #{useYn}, #{updAt}, #{updBy})
mapper.select: SELECT s.SECTION_CD, s.SECTION_NM, s.SECTION_DESC, s.SECTION_TYPE, s.CARD_ICON, s.LINK_URL, s.SORT_ORD, s.USE_YN, s.UPD_AT, s.UPD_BY, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PRD_TAB_ITEM i WHERE i.SECTION_CD = s.SECTION_CD AND i.USE_YN = 'Y') AS ITEM_CNT FROM TB_PRD_TAB_SECTION s ORDER BY s.SORT_ORD, s.SECTION_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRD_TAB_SECTION (SECTION_CD, SECTION_NM, SECTION_DESC, SECTION_TYPE, CARD_ICON, LINK_URL, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY) VALUES (#{sectionCd}, #{sectionNm}, #{sectionDesc}, #{sectionType}, #{cardIcon}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortOrd}, #{useYn}, #{updAt}, #{updBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SECTION_NM = VALUES(SECTION_NM), SECTION_DESC = VALUES(SECTION_DESC), SECTION_TYPE = VALUES(SECTION_TYPE), CARD_ICON = VALUES(CARD_ICON), LINK_URL = VALUES(LINK_URL), SORT_ORD = VALUES(SORT_ORD), USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN), UPD_AT = VALUES(UPD_AT), UPD_BY = VALUES(UPD_BY)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_PRD_TAB_ITEM i LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_CD = i.PRODUCT_CD WHERE i.SECTION_CD = #{sectionCd} ORDER BY i.SORT_ORD, i.PRODUCT_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRD_TAB_ITEM (SECTION_CD, PRODUCT_CD, SORT_ORD, BADGE_TEXT, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY) VALUES (#{sectionCd}, #{productCd}, #{sortOrd}, #{badgeText}, #{useYn}, #{updAt}, #{updBy})
mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_CD, PRODUCT_NM, PRODUCT_KIND, SUB_TYPE, ON_SALE_YN FROM TB_PRODUCT ORDER BY PRODUCT_KIND, PRODUCT_NM
